text: Explain how a city can reduce traffic congestion without requiring every resident to buy an electric car.
Describe the difference between a meteor, a meteoroid, and a meteorite using a clear example.
A small nonprofit has limited funds. Suggest a transparent way to compare three projects competing for support.
Write a Python example that safely reads a CSV file and reports rows with missing values.
How does sleep affect learning and memory? Mention one limitation in interpreting studies on this topic.
Compare a fixed-rate mortgage with a variable-rate mortgage and identify questions a borrower should ask.
Explain how the pH scale works and why a small numerical change can represent a large chemical difference.
Predloži način da komšije podele obaveze oko uređenja zajedničkog dvorišta i reše neslaganja.
Describe how a compiler detects a type error and explain why some errors only appear while a program runs.
What evidence would help a farmer decide whether to switch part of a field to drought-resistant crops?
Explain how a search engine can rank pages and why the highest-ranked result is not always the most reliable.
A library wants to extend evening hours. Design a small survey that avoids leading questions.
Describe how ocean currents move heat around the planet and how that can influence coastal weather.
Give an intuitive explanation of eigenvectors and eigenvalues using a transformation that stretches space.
How should a family prepare a practical emergency kit for a winter power outage? Explain what to check regularly.
Compare public-key and symmetric encryption, then explain why secure systems often use both.
Explain why some metals rust faster than others and name environmental factors that change the rate.
Write a short guide for checking whether a graph in a news article uses a misleading scale.
How can a teacher make a group project fair when students have different schedules and strengths?
Objasni kako funkcioniše reciklaža aluminijuma i uporedi njenu potrošnju energije sa proizvodnjom novog metala.
Describe the difference between a scientific hypothesis, a theory, and a law without treating them as levels of certainty.
A website is slow only for some users. List a diagnostic sequence that separates network, browser, and server causes.
Explain how a city can measure whether a new bus route improves access to jobs and services.
Give a balanced comparison of handwritten notes and typed notes for remembering a lecture.
